scoring_justification: The checker cannot recompute Wagner diffusivities from raw SKMF simulation data in a lightweight verifier; instead it scores the internal consistency (relative difference ≤ 20%) and sanity range of the reported diffusivities, and compares the equilibrium boundaries to the paper's common-tangent values within a 0.01 tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Equilibrium phase boundaries from paper Table I (common tangents rule)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper J. Chem. Phys. 150, 174109 (2019), Table I – Common tangents rule values
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's published table
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact boundaries reported in the paper for the identical interaction parameters and temperature, ensuring the reference solution corresponds to the paper's own thermodynamic calculation.

outputs.description: Equilibrium concentration boundaries for phases A(B), AB3, AB, A3B, B(A) at 750 K.
Growth-derived and Matano-derived Wagner diffusivities for A3B phase.
Growth-derived and Matano-derived Wagner diffusivities for AB phase.

output_contract.notes: The first output provides the equilibrium phase boundaries needed for subsequent simulations. The second and third outputs contain the Wagner diffusivities; the checker will compute the relative difference between growth_DW and Matano_DW and verify it does not exceed 0.20. Values should fall within plausible physical range (1e-14 to 1e-12 m²/s).
